text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука dominates this battle
between
multiple years of racers and
flies past the finish
line like a gust of
wind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Rather than feel embittered by their
loss, El
Condor Pasa and Грасс Вандер
enthusiastically
swear to one day
overcome Сайленс Судзука.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Спешл Уик is also inspired by the
exhilarating
race and becomes filled
with the motivation to
surpass Silence
Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука herself swears to work
hard to
keep the lead against Special
Week. She simply
can't wait for the
autumn Tenno Sho!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
